snippet.title: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator | Heavy South DLC | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The new "Heavy South" DLC for Heavy Cargo – The Truck Simulator -  available now on PC, PlayStation 5 & XBOX Series X|S! 

The new "Heavy South" DLC 🏔️ brings an extensive expansion of the map to the south, doubling the size of the game world. Additionally, you can look forward to 31 exciting new heavy and super heavy missions, along with new delivery locations, cargo types, trailers, and a brand-new route mission. Master the wide variety of new missions, enjoy the breathtaking mountain atmosphere, and take on new challenges in heavy and super-heavy transport.

Here’s what you can expect from the DLC:

🗺️ Expansion of the map to the south
📋 31 new handcrafted missions
⌛ Countless new combinations of procedural missions in economy mode
🏗️ 6 new delivery locations
🚛 3 new trailers
📦 Over 20 new cargo types
🚧 A brand-new route mission

🔗 Steam: https://links.aerosoft.com/HeavySouth-S  
🔗 PlayStation 5: https://links.aerosoft.com/HeavySouth-P  
🔗 XBOX Series X|S: https://links.aerosoft.com/HeavySouth-X 

#HeavyCargo #TruckSimulator #HeavySouth #DLC #MadeWithUnity
